findings: Double auth check per protected page — (protected)/layout.tsx already calls getAdminSession() and redirects; each page also calls requireAdminSession() which calls getAdminSession() a second time. Remove per-page calls since the layout guard is authoritative.

AdminInquiriesTable silently ignores a failed mark-as-handled response — markHandled calls router.refresh() unconditionally in the finally block. A 404 or 500 from the server gives the admin no feedback. Check res.ok and surface an error message before refreshing.

VALID_STATUSES array in the status route is a manual copy of ApplicationStatus values from schema.ts — these two sources can drift if the schema adds a new status. Consider deriving the array from the schema type instead.
